name: Refactor shared date formatting utility across 5 consumer files
description: Extend formatDate in src/utils/format.ts to support custom format tokens and update consumers in src/views and src/reports.

inputs.task_prompt: Update formatDate in src/utils/format.ts to accept an optional format template string (default: 'YYYY-MM-DD'). Supported tokens: YYYY (4-digit year), MM (2-digit month), DD (2-digit day), HH (2-digit hour 00-23), mm (2-digit minute), ss (2-digit second). Update all 5 consumer files (profile.ts, activity.ts, billing.ts, summary.ts, audit.ts) to pass their required format strings. All tests in test/format.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: formatDate supports custom tokens YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss
